The forest interval is called 95 percent here, 90 percent in the summary, and the results sentence says 95 percent confidence for the United States increase. The ranking sentence says 2024 inside a 2028 section.
The sum index and the category index collide, and t is also the coach score. Three different six-class name lists are not merged. The heatmap triangles are not equal.
The two printed expressions for alpha are not equal. Alpha is called a significant level, P is called a confidence level, and the later prose calls P a P-value. Table 5 is captioned Table Title.
